from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u002/system/state/workspace/programs')

path=base/'task-8acb8f16.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows else 0
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells) + 1
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells) + 1
    h, w = r1-r0, c1-c0
    return [row[c0:c0+w//2] for row in grid[r0:r0+h//2]]
'''
path.write_text(source)
ns={}
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'),ns)
